title: trailboss --json task show
description: One task, as the card to read before accepting it: an object (not an array) with every field of its `task ls` row, and what it did. The summary is the agent's last message, read from the local index: it's for you, and Trailboss never logs or sends it anywhere.

state.description: to do, working, needs you, reviewing, ready, done or missing; more may be added.

detail.description: Why: the agent's status or what it waits on, or how it ended.

commits.description: Commits on its branch that the base branch doesn't have; null once done.

files.description: Files its branch changed; null once done.

uncommitted.description: Changed paths not committed in its worktree; null once done or gone.

where.description: Where its agent runs now, as `live` says; null when none is.

session.description: AGENT:ID of its agent's session: the one live in its terminal, else the latest indexed in its worktree.

summary.description: The agent's last message in that session; null when none is indexed.

changed.description: Files its branch changed since it left the base branch; null once done.

path.description: Relative to the repository; `old => new` for a rename.

added.description: Lines added; null for a binary file.

removed.description: Lines removed; null for a binary file.

checks.description: Checks known to have run on its session or in its worktree: `until` loops running there. Empty when none is known.

check.description: The check's command, its words joined by spaces.

by.description: What ran it: until; more may be added.

passed.description: How it ended last time; null before it has run.

can_accept.description: Whether `task accept <n> --yes` would merge it now.

accept_blocked.description: Why accept would refuse it now, as accept would say; null when it would go through.

log.description: Commits on its branch the base branch doesn't have, newest first (`commits` counts them); null once done (its branch is gone).

review.description: Whether a second agent reviews its work before it's ready: `task add --review`, or the config's `tasks.review`; `task review` turns it on.

notes.description: The file its latest reviewer wrote its notes to, once written; null before.

reviewer.description: Its review, when it's on or one ran: the latest reviewer and the notes it wrote, read from their file and printed for you only. Null when review is off and none ran.

reviews.description: Reviewers started for it so far.

agent.description: The latest reviewer's definition; null before one started.

where.description: Where the reviewer runs now, as `live` says; null when it doesn't.

notes.description: The file it was asked to write its notes to, in `task-reviews/` beside the index.

text.description: Its notes (the first 256 KiB); null until written.
